methodology.positionLimit: One BANKNIFTY index-equivalent position at a time
methodology.signals: All signals use completed 15-minute candles only
methodology.execution: Signal at candle close; fill at following candle open
methodology.stops: Protective stop is fixed before each candle; gaps fill at candle open
methodology.trailing: Trailing levels update only after candle close and apply from the following candle
methodology.eod: Any open position exits at the 15:15-labelled candle close (15:30)
methodology.optimization: Entry and exit rules ranked on train; finalists selected using train plus development; untouched period opened once for final validation
methodology.limitation: Index-point simulation, not historical futures-contract fills or rupee P&L
